item.title: Business, peace, and human rights in high-risk markets
item.content:encoded:
This special issue addresses the complex intersection of business operations, peacebuilding efforts, and human rights protection in challenging geopolitical contexts. The call seeks research examining how corporations navigate and contribute to these interconnected concerns in volatile markets where conflict, instability, or governance challenges create significant risks and ethical dilemmas.

Appel publié par Business Horizons. Voir l'appel sur le site de l'éditeur. Fiche de l'appel sur kerostig.

Potential topics

  • Business and peace
  • Human rights
  • High-risk markets
  • Business ethics

Timeline

  • June 1, 2027: Submission deadline

item.title: Managing for Tomorrow: How organizational culture, values, and character impact crisis management and crisis communication
item.content:encoded:
This special issue examines the relationship between organizational culture, values, and character, and their influence on how organizations manage and communicate during crises. The call seeks research that explores how these organizational attributes shape crisis response strategies and outcomes.

The issue is directed at scholars interested in understanding the deeper organizational factors that determine crisis management effectiveness and the quality of crisis communication in business contexts.

Appel publié par Business Horizons. Voir l'appel sur le site de l'éditeur. Fiche de l'appel sur kerostig.

Potential topics

  • Organizational culture and crisis management
  • Organizational values and crisis response
  • Organizational character in crises
  • Crisis communication strategies
  • Impact of culture on crisis handling

Timeline

  • January 7, 2028: Submission deadline

item.title: Reimagining the business of medicine: Navigating transformational technology, consolidation, workforce transition, and physician leadership

item.title: Corporate duty of care and liability in the age of advanced AI: Legal risk, accountability, and corporate exposure
item.content:encoded:
This special issue examines the evolving legal responsibilities and accountability frameworks that organizations must navigate as artificial intelligence technologies become increasingly sophisticated and integrated into business operations. The focus is on understanding corporate duty of care obligations, liability exposures, and the regulatory landscape that governs AI use in corporate settings.
